results.title: Avatar Aang Marketing Error Credits Shyamalan in 4K Release
results.description: Promotional materials for Avatar Aang 4K UHD SteelBook mistakenly credited M. Night Shyamalan instead of Lauren Montgomery, confusing the animated feature with the 2010 live-action film.

results.title: Why Charlene Ruto’s white wedding was held in Tanzania, not Kenya
results.description: President William Ruto’s daughter, Charlene Ruto, exchanged vows with Tanzanian entrepreneur Isaya Yunge in a white wedding ceremony
